<a name="stagger"></a>

## stagger(elements, [options]) ⇒ <code>Promise.&lt;Array.&lt;MotionResult&gt;&gt;</code>
Animate a unique iterable of shells with delay + index * interval timing.
Validate all elements and computed delays before starting the first phase.

**Kind**: global function<br>
**Returns**: <code>Promise.&lt;Array.&lt;MotionResult&gt;&gt;</code> - Statuses in input order.<br>
**Throws**:

- <code>TypeError</code> When the iterable contains invalid or duplicate elements.
- <code>RangeError</code> When any timing, including a computed delay, is outside 0–60000ms.


| Param | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| elements | <code>Iterable.&lt;(HTMLElement\|SVGElement)&gt;</code> |  | Unique target shells. |
| [options] | <code>StaggerOptions</code> | <code>{}</code> | Motion options and interval (85ms by default). |
